title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
lineage: This is a remaster of shnid 28882

ai_review.summary: Audience-sourced recording captures a fun, smile‑inducing jam with prominent vocals and Jerry’s guitar.
ai_review.review: The lone review praises this impromptu show for its infectious joy – the vocals sit front‑and‑center and Jerry Garcia's guitar shines through, making the jam impossible not to smile at. The audience recording is described as clear enough to highlight those elements, delivering a high‑energy performance despite the lack of an official setlist.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights both an excellent musical vibe and good sound clarity; with only one data point the rating is optimistic but confidence remains low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Prominent vocals and clear Jerry Garcia guitar noted; no technical complaints reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Impromptu, relaxed set that kept the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work described as prominent and enjoyable.
